Reliance Jio, India’s largest telecom operator, has also built the largest 5G FWA (fixed wireless access) business in the country. The telco has added the most 5G FWA users in September 2026. When it comes to FWA, Jio is always ahead of competition, every month. Because Jio’s FWA is also extended to UBR (unlicensed band radio) services. So while the UBR numbers are reported separately, the service is under Jio Home only. In the homes business, Jio is steadily adding new customers, which will result in high returns in the future as these are high paying customers. Let’s take a look at the numbers for September 2026, published by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) on its website.
Jio Adds More than 3 Lakh Wireless Home Users in September 2026
Both the FWA and UBR services are under wireless category of home services. Jio has added more than 3 lakh users combined in this. In the 5G FWA, Jio added 98,386 users month-over-month (MoM). Airtel, in comparison only added 53,354 users. In the UBR category, Jio added 2,15,469 users MoM. Airtel did not add a single user in this category since it does not provide UBR services.
Jio is adding home users at a fast speed. In the wireline category, Jio added 1,34,279 users, the most by any Internet Service Provider (ISP) in the month. Comparitively, Airtel added 1,24,259 users only. Both BSNL (Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited) and Vodafone Idea (Vi) were also able to add new users in the wireline segment, but not as much as Jio and Airtel.
The total FWA subscriber base of Jio has touched 9.5 million while Airtel’s stands at 4.08 million. Jio also has 5.58 million UBR customers. So it is safe to say that Jio is miles ahead of Bharti Airtel in the homes segment. Jio has also launched TV only plans recently in order to push the homes services revenues in the coming quarters.

en_body:
According to official data published by the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI), Reliance Jio maintained its leading position in India's home broadband and fixed wireless access (FWA) segments for September 2026. Industry reports indicate that Jio continues to outperform competitors in monthly subscriber additions across both wireless and wireline categories.

## September 2026 Subscriber Growth Breakdown
TRAI's published figures highlight significant gains by major telecom operators in the Indian market:

* **5G FWA Additions:** Reliance Jio added 98,386 users month-over-month, while competitor Bharti Airtel added 53,354 users.
* **Unlicensed Band Radio (UBR):** Jio added 2,15,469 users in the UBR category. Airtel recorded no additions in this segment as it does not offer UBR services.
* **Wireline Additions:** Jio led all Internet Service Providers (ISPs) by adding 1,34,279 wireline users, closely followed by Airtel with 1,24,259 additions. State-run BSNL and Vodafone Idea (Vi) also reported modest gains in the wireline segment.

## Total Subscriber Base and Market Standing
Combined figures for Jio's wireless home services—encompassing both FWA and UBR—surpassed 3 lakh net additions for September 2026. 

* **FWA Base:** Jio's total FWA subscriber base reached approximately 9.5 million, compared to Airtel's 4.08 million.
* **UBR Base:** Jio reported 5.58 million UBR customers.
* **Strategic Offerings:** To further strengthen its home services revenue, Jio recently introduced TV-only plans aimed at capturing a larger share of the home entertainment market.

## Practical Implications and Verification
For consumers and industry analysts, tracking these monthly metrics provides insight into the expanding adoption of high-speed fixed wireless and fiber broadband across India. Interested readers and stakeholders can independently verify these figures by visiting the official Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) website, where monthly subscription data and press releases are publicly archived.
